facts.fact: 开篇是 Simone 播报紧急天气预警：一股强冷锋正向 Keys 推进并将引发严重雷暴。
facts.anchor: This is Simone with an urgent weather advisory. A powerful cold front is moving down toward the Keys

facts.fact: 气象报告称风暴移动很快，Paradise 正处在风暴路径上。
facts.anchor: According to meteorologist reports, it’s moving very quickly. Paradise is in the path of the storm

facts.fact: 广播要求所有客人立即到 Welcome Center 集合，让家人团聚并就地避险。
facts.anchor: We request that all guests report to the Welcome Center immediately, so families can meet and shelter in place together.

facts.fact: 瞭望员和辅导员将指挥这次行动，广播请大家有序严格服从指示。
facts.anchor: Lookouts and counselors will be leading this operation, so please follow their instructions very carefully and in an orderly fashion.

facts.fact: 结尾承诺有进一步消息会再播报，并提前感谢大家的配合。
facts.anchor: We will provide further updates when available. Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
